answer.REST-meta-MDD: normative training for model-1 and clinical analysis

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The 524 HCs from the REST-meta-MDD dataset were used to train the normative model (hierarchical Bayesian regression). The same dataset (MDD patients and HCs) was then analyzed using the deviations (z-scores) from this model.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "generate normative models using the covariates of sex, age, and education. The deviations (z statistics) for each participant... were computed and submitted for the above statistical analysis."
